summary: System prompt construction matches Decision 6: ux-guidelines.md verbatim, JSON envelope appended after horizontal rule, model = claude-haiku-4-5, max_tokens=8000. User message is structured JSON (not free-text concatenation) — eliminates a major prompt-injection vector at the prompt-design layer. Envelope is module-level constant (no per-call rebuild).

findings.title: ux-guidelines.md loaded verbatim with rstrip()
findings.description: _build_system_prompt does prompt_body.rstrip() before appending the envelope. This is whitespace cleanup at the trailing boundary, not paraphrasing. ux-guidelines.md line 17 states 'Treat the text below as your role' — the role text inside the blockquote is preserved byte-for-byte.
findings.resolution: OK. rstrip is the standard 'no trailing whitespace before separator' idiom.

findings.title: JSON envelope schema matches code-research §14.3
findings.description: Envelope specifies title (with emoji prefix from the 8-emoji set), alts (2-3 alternates), subtitle, paragraphs (length-locked), blocks (length+type-mirrored). Envelope text is the verbatim block from §14.3.

findings.title: Paragraph-count constraint enforced both in prompt + parse
findings.description: Prompt envelope says 'paragraphs MUST contain EXACTLY the same length as input'. _parse_response validates this on response. Two-layer defence: prompt-level instruction + structural validation.

findings.title: User message is structured JSON, not free-text concatenation
findings.description: _build_user_message uses json.dumps to serialise the article. Adversarial paragraph content cannot escape the JSON string boundary into the system-prompt context — this is the standard prompt-injection mitigation pattern for instruction-content separation.

findings.title: No prompt caching
findings.description: Per Decision 6, prompt caching is disabled — slot interval (40+ min) exceeds 5-min cache TTL, no break-even. No cache control headers in the SDK call.

findings.title: Title emoji safety-net regex copied verbatim from legacy
findings.description: _apply_emoji_safety_net cascade matches news_bot.py:404-423 word-for-word. Per task spec: 'Скопировать паттерны как есть; не пытаться их улучшать в этой задаче.'

findings.title: No prompt leakage in error paths
findings.description: Neither system prompt nor user message text is echoed into raised exception messages. _classify_exception only includes type name + str(exc) of the SDK error.

verification.decision_alignment: Decision 6 (system prompt), Decision 8 (flat fallback), Decision 13 (max_tokens, paragraph validation, defensive truncation) — all matched.
